meaning: Explicit reconciled source, checked-snapshot and CLI verification use one complete executor and retain every unmet requirement; verification does not publish application output.
selection: Validate inert closed compilation selection and tool options before reading source, observing target or spawning validators. The source wrapper loads the current graph once; the checked-snapshot wrapper plans from the registered graph and the executor separately checks source currentness. Never silently reload a stale snapshot into a different candidate.
public_api: Preserve the two-argument legacy verifyProject signature and behavior. An explicit selection plus tool-options overload delegates to reconciled source verification. Provide direct source and compiled-snapshot reconciled wrappers, retaining the executor report type rather than labeling it a legacy passing receipt. Reject partial selected calls and conflicting target roots before effects.
cli: With --compilation-selection, verify-project requires one absolute source root, --target-root, --typescript-root, --node-type-root and --lean-executable. Tool paths are explicit inputs to the existing trusted local-validator boundary, not arbitrary generated commands. An optional --output-layout selects the existing application layout. Reject duplicates, unknown or missing options and unsupported layouts before source access. Emit one complete execution report to stdout; pass exits zero, fail or incomplete exits one. Invalid arguments/input use the existing diagnostic envelope. Omitted selection preserves the legacy command.
layout: Only the existing explicit application-layout/v1 is supported. Existing output currentness uses the same mapped complete whole-project view and receipt as publication, including compositions. Bind the selected layout into the execution report and currentness evidence; omitted layout retains plain output. Native checks use exact original artifact bytes in the private workspace since the existing layout only prefixes their common root. Do not discover a layout from target files or fall back to plain output.
claim_boundary: No generated application behavior execution, target publication, provider call, default cutover or stronger semantic assurance is introduced. Keep selected-generator, cross-generator, composition behavior and separate safe-output checks explicit and not_evaluable until their own evidence exists. A nonzero incomplete result is useful progress, not completion of R08 or the CLI.
sources: Add this definition to the compiled capsule; preserve all 41 previous source pins.
validation: Native source/snapshot/API/CLI execution equivalence with complete composition reports and both output layouts
Malformed selection/tool/layout and conflicting-target inputs reject before source reads, target writes or validator spawns
Stale snapshot, mismatched layout and target drift cannot produce a passing report
Pinned TypeScript declarations preserve legacy and selected call types; generated CLI works outside checkout
Single JSON result, nonzero incomplete/fail, no output mutation and private workspace cleanup
